notes.title: Postpone the release
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38431062/073cfd5aeac9ce39c03d9b0b5c86e4fe8db34747.png

We are sorry to inform that we could not complete the preparatory work in time for the release and have postponed the release.
We apologize to the fans who have been looking forward to the release of this product, but we would appreciate it if you could wait a little longer.
We will inform of the release date as soon as it is decided.

notes.title: 「Succubus Connect」 Notice: Release date postponed
notes.notes:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38431062/cdbd185a13884bd96264931f2454ee03cf53b646.png

News from Wasabi Entertainment.

We will postpone the release of Succubus Connect.
It will be released on May 14.

We are sorry for the delay of release.

Thank you.
